main.description: Everything needed to judge one account: its status, the labels on it and on its records, the reports against them, a sample of its records and how many it has of each kind. Requires an admin session.

records.description: The newest few of each collection.

labels.description: The labels standing on the account and on each of its records.

reports.description: Every report against the account or one of its records, newest first.

childSafety.description: Whether a child-safety report or label (csae) was ever made against the account or one of its records, in any state: what it holds is for a person to judge, never a model.
